title: State-sponsored Cyber Attacks on Singapore Government Systems
what_it_is: State-sponsored Cyber Attacks on Singapore Government Systems

sections.label: Cyber monitoring and response
sections.summary: Singapore was not listed as an affected country, and CSA and GovTech monitor threats and respond to cyber attacks on critical computer systems.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Singapore was not listed as an affected country.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: The Cyber Security Agency (CSA) and Government Technology Agency (GovTech) work with our security agencies to monitor threats and respond to any cyber attack on our critical computer systems.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Given their sensitive nature, we are unable to publicly discuss such operations and responses.

sections.label: Government cyber preventive measures
sections.summary: Preventive and proactive measures include Secure Internet Surfing, security testing, 24/7 monitoring, and Incident Response Teams to contain and remediate attacks.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: One example of a preventive measure would be the Secure Internet Surfing, blocking Government workstations from malicious content.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: An example of a proactive measure is putting Government digital services through security testing to discover and remediate any potential vulnerabilities that may be there.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: For the systems that are online, our Security Operation Centre monitors the devices and networks 24/7 to detect attacks.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Should suspicious or malicious activities or payloads be detected, our Incident Response Teams are prepared to contain quickly any attack, investigate the incident, carry out the necessary remediation and follow-up actions for recovery.

sections.label: CSA framework and designations
sections.summary: CSA's framework and the Cybersecurity Act address systems of systems, deriving designations of Critical Information Infrastructure and Significant Information Infrastructure.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: Is there ongoing attention to such convergences of risk as well?

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: That sense of looking at the systems, systems of systems and the interactions between the various components of the systems is indeed the very framework that CSA takes and the Cybersecurity Act is applied to, and it is how we then derive the designation of Critical Information Infrastructure and Significant Information Infrastructure.
